lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，鳍扫起细沙。
lines.en: I swim low over the sand, fins sweeping dust.

lines.zh: 水浅得只够盖住我的背。
lines.en: The water is shallow enough to barely cover my back.

lines.zh: 太阳把这片池水烤得温热。
lines.en: The sun bakes this pool lukewarm.

lines.zh: 我们三条并排，绕过石头。
lines.en: The three of us swim abreast around the stones.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我鳃边不停打转。
lines.en: Grains of sand swirl past my gills.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，水实在太浅。
lines.en: I swim slowly; the water really is too shallow.
The desert wind wrinkles the water's surface.
My scales pale under the fierce sun.

lines.zh: 前方没有水草，只有干岸。
lines.en: No weeds ahead, only a dry bank.

lines.zh: 我摆尾转身，惊起一圈涟漪。
lines.en: I flick my tail and ring the water.

lines.zh: 这片水是绿洲最后的水。
lines.en: This pool is the oasis's last water.
I hide inside the palm's shadow.

lines.zh: 棕榈的根须从我身边垂下。
lines.en: Palm roots dangle beside me in the water.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸边巡游，找阴凉。
lines.en: I cruise the bank looking for cooler shade.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里游，背鳍露出一点点。
lines.en: I swim the shallows with my dorsal barely showing.

lines.zh: 我抢在同伴前面，冲向那块阴影。
lines.en: I cut ahead of my schoolmates, dash for that shade.

lines.zh: 水面被风推着晃，我也跟着晃。
lines.en: Wind ripples the surface, and I ride the sway.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，往水草更密的地方去。
lines.en: I turn and head for thicker weeds.
The surface is too bright; I squint.

lines.zh: 我等着棕榈叶上的虫子掉下来。
lines.en: I wait for a bug to drop off a palm frond.
Dry season is here; the water shrinks daily.
I poke my mouth up to gulp air.

lines.zh: 池底有块暖石头，我靠着。
lines.en: A warm stone on the bottom; I lean on it.

lines.zh: 我听见远处沙丘上的风。
lines.en: I hear wind across the far dunes.
Of the three of us, I swim slowest.

lines.zh: 光斑在沙底晃，我追不上。
lines.en: Light patches waver on the sand; I cannot catch them.

lines.zh: 池水太暖，我连鳃都懒得动。
lines.en: The pool is so warm even my gills slacken.
This water tastes salty; I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我盯着岸上那棵枯棕榈。
lines.en: I stare at the dead palm on the bank.
Bone grit lies white in the sand beneath me.

lines.zh: 我在想雨季什么时候来。
lines.en: I wonder when the rainy season will come.
Quiet, save water dripping into the pool.

lines.zh: 你踩在干岸上，影子先下水。
lines.en: You stand on dry ground; your shadow enters first.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，嘴一张一合。
lines.en: I look up at you, mouth opening and closing.
Your boots crack the wet mud.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once inside your shadow.
Will you catch me, or only look?
I know the smell of a bucket.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，水照出你的脸。
lines.en: You crouch; the water mirrors your face.
I turn sideways so you see my scales.
Do not put your hand in; the water clouds.
I watch you the way I watch clouds.
The blade lands and my scales flip up.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，红得很快。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water, red and quick.
The pain sends me knocking into the pool wall.
I hide in a rock crevice, gills pumping.
That blow nearly knocks me out.
The water muddies; I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 胸鳍裂开，我游得一歪一歪。
lines.en: My pectoral fin splits; I swim in lopsided jerks.
I sink onto the sand and play dead.
Your strike is faster than an osprey's.
The pool is too small; there is nowhere to flee.
Is that bread crumb, or a grain of sand?

lines.zh: 我闻到一点甜味，靠近了。
lines.en: I smell something sweet and drift closer.

lines.zh: 你指间夹着东西，还在动。
lines.en: Something is pinched between your fingers, still moving.
I circle away, then swim back.

lines.zh: 旱季里，任何吃的都值得。
lines.en: In dry season, any food is worth it.
I open my mouth, close it, hesitate.

lines.zh: 这味道不像绿洲里的东西。
lines.en: This scent is not from the oasis.

lines.zh: 我尾鳍抖了一下，忍不住。
lines.en: My tail twitches; I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 你抖了抖手，碎屑落下来。
lines.en: You shake your hand and crumbs fall.
Just one bite, I tell myself.

lines.zh: 你撞进水里，池底翻起沙。
lines.en: You crash in; sand billows from the bottom.
The bump pins me against a stone.

lines.zh: 水晃得厉害，我抓不住方向。
lines.en: The water churns; I lose my bearings.

lines.zh: 你的腿扫过，我急忙躲开。
lines.en: Your leg sweeps past; I dart aside.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，鳞片发麻。
lines.en: I hit your boot and my scales sting.
Do not step there; the pool is this small.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，尾鳍拍出水花。
lines.en: I skirt around you, tail slapping spray.
Silt clogs my gills.

lines.zh: 我们挤在角落，谁也没动。
lines.en: We crowd the corner, neither of us moving.
You step back and the water settles.

lines.zh: 雨季的水涨起来才谈这个。
lines.en: We discuss this when the rains raise the water.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，沙底画出圈。
lines.en: I circle my mate, tracing rings in the sand.
My mate is a hand smaller, fins bright.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳍几乎碰到。
lines.en: We swim abreast, our fins almost touching.
This pool is too small for two broods.
I scoop a shallow pit in the sand.

lines.zh: 它的鳞在阳光下像铜片。
lines.en: Its scales look like copper in the sun.

lines.zh: 我们守着坑，赶走别的鱼。
lines.en: We guard the pit and chase the others off.
Before the dry season, the eggs must be hidden.

lines.zh: 三条鱼里，只有我们配对。
lines.en: Of the three of us, only we have paired.
The bucket dips; I know what it means.
I butt the bucket wall, scales rasping.
Away from oasis water, I will dry out.
The swaying bucket makes me dizzy.
Which water are you carrying me to?
I circle the bucket bottom, hunting an exit.
This water has no sand smell; it is strange.

lines.zh: 我跳了一下，桶盖挡住了。
lines.en: I jump once; the lid stops me.
Do not leave me in the desert.
At least there is still water in here.
The ripples are wrong; something moves.

lines.zh: 我转向岸上那串脚步声。
lines.en: I turn toward that string of footsteps on the bank.
The shadow on the bank is long and straight.
Something has come near the pool's edge.
I stop fanning my tail and listen.
That is not an insect falling in.
I sink my body against the sand.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯着那道晃动的光。
lines.en: My eyes lock on that wavering light.
I back off half a foot, then stop.

lines.zh: 这池子没有第二个出口。
lines.en: This pool has no second exit.
I circle it, tail held stiff.

lines.zh: 它一弯腰，我立刻横过来。
lines.en: The moment it bends, I turn broadside.
I hug the bottom and creep closer.
Sand whispers beneath my belly.
I open my mouth; I have no teeth.
In this water, speed is all I have.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的影子，不是它。
lines.en: I fix on its shadow, not on it.
One tail-length of distance left.
My gills work faster now.
If it turns, I charge.
I butt my head against its leg, weakly.
That blow did not even loosen a scale.
I bite, and my mouth fills with water.
My tail slaps across like a fan.
All I have left is bumping and dodging.
It steps back; I chase half a foot.
My teeth are too small to grip cloth.

lines.zh: 水里打架，我占一点便宜。
lines.en: In the water I have a small advantage.

lines.zh: 我撞完就游开，怕被抓住。
lines.en: I strike, then flee before being caught.

lines.zh: 我这条命薄，经不起几下。
lines.en: My life is thin; it will not take many blows.

lines.zh: 我从绿洲的浅水里醒过来。
lines.en: I wake in the oasis's shallow water.

lines.zh: 沙底很暖，像晒过的石头。
lines.en: The sand is warm, like sunned stone.

lines.zh: 周围只有干裂的岸和棕榈。
lines.en: Around me, only cracked banks and palms.

lines.zh: 我摆尾试了试水有多深。
lines.en: I flick my tail to test the depth.
This channel is narrower than I thought.
The sun shines straight down on the pool.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有骆驼的铃。
lines.en: I hear camel bells far away.

lines.zh: 三条鱼，一起从沙里出来。
lines.en: Three of us rise together from the sand.
There is not much water, but enough to live.
I decide to swim one lap first.
The surface is burning; I burrow into the sand.

lines.zh: 被甩上岸，我在干沙上扑腾。
lines.en: Thrown onto land, I thrash on dry sand.

lines.zh: 我在水里却喘不上气，很怪。
lines.en: Underwater yet unable to breathe; strange.

lines.zh: 冲击把整池水掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole pool into the air.

lines.zh: 箭从水面射下来，钉进沙里。
lines.en: An arrow stabs down through the water into sand.

lines.zh: 光落进池子，我的鳞发烫。
lines.en: Light falls into the pool and my scales burn.

lines.zh: 绿洲里没什么可吃，我瘦了。
lines.en: Little to eat in the oasis; I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷落在棕榈上，水面发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the palm and the water tingles.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，只有下坠。
lines.en: In the void there is no water, only falling.
